description.p: OpenDSS models electric power distribution feeders for power flow and time-series studies, including studies of distributed energy resources. Edit DSS scripts, solve circuits, plot feeder results, and export voltages and power flows as CSV files.

This community package downloads EPRI’s official Windows installer at Flatpak install time. Cellar runs it unmodified under Wine and sets up a private, persistent Wine prefix on first launch. The first launch takes longer while the installer runs.
Wine is a separate dependency shared with other Wine apps. Install it with flatpak install flathub org.winehq.Wine//stable-26.08.

Open and save models and reports in H:\Documents. To give OpenDSS access to another folder in your home directory, for example H:\Models, run flatpak override --user --filesystem="$HOME/Models" com.epri.OpenDSS. Reset overrides with flatpak override --user --reset com.epri.OpenDSS.

The package supplies Windows Python 3.12, NumPy and pywin32 for pyControl and registers EPRI’s bundled DSSpyServer unless a registration already exists. Add set pyPath=P:\python before creating a pyControl object. If an example already sets pyPath, replace that line in your copy of the model.
The interface follows your desktop scale by default. If the text or controls are too small, choose a larger size. Restart OpenDSS after changing the setting.

ul.li: Example for larger text and controls: flatpak run --command=cellar com.epri.OpenDSS config dpi=168
Restore automatic scaling: flatpak run --command=cellar com.epri.OpenDSS config dpi=auto
